hypothesis: LingBot-aligned q01/q99 action normalization increases the paired s100 held-out action improvement by at least 0.25 percentage points over the min/max s100 arm while preserving positive video improvement.
single_variable: Replace per-dimension global min/max action normalization clipped to [-1,1] with q01/q99 normalization clipped to [-1.5,1.5]. Initialization, seed, first 800 dense windows, architecture, optimizer and noise schedules remain fixed.
parent_baseline: E17 min/max s100: paired val40 action improvement 0.453% and video improvement 2.166% from its own initialization.

references.title: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control

architecture.upstream_code: four streams traverse shared Wan blocks
architecture.local: four streams traverse shared H3 blocks; tail-2 trainable
architecture.rationale: H3 port remains fixed across paired arms.

data.local: q01/q99 computed once over all 277713 raw action frames; train uses the same first 800 windows as E17
data.rationale: All suites contribute once per raw frame; overlapping windows do not bias statistics.

action.local: same formula and clipping on seven active LIBERO channels
action.rationale: The local raw gripper is [0,1] rather than upstream [-1,1], but each maps exactly to normalized [-1,1] under its own quantiles.

objective.local: video velocity MSE + action velocity MSE
objective.rationale: No invented action-loss multiplier is introduced.

optimization.rationale: A cheap mechanism gate precedes any long training.

evaluation.local: same-noise val40 in each normalization space; causal sample40 only after teacher-forced gate
evaluation.rationale: Percentage improvement from each arm's own initialization is comparable despite different units.

evidence: 1712 episodes, 277713 raw frames, explicit quantile artifact
upstream and local both sum video and action losses
normalization finite; maximum quantile clip fraction 0.37%
checkpoint stores and validates normalization identity
quantile normalization expands rotational action std by 1.31-2.12x

decision.rationale: First measure quantile initialization val40, then train s100 and repeat val40. Continue to causal sample40 only if action improvement is at least 0.703% (E17 plus 0.25 percentage points) and video remains positive. Otherwise stop this route without rollout.
